text:
Maya Chen: Quick check-in for marketplace launch readiness. Need owners for: EdgeBox AMIs/OVAs, cloud listing assets (GCP/Azure), SI demo flow, embargoed blog + press kit, landing A/B variants, and localization. Freeze target: Fri 2025-08-01 18:00 PT. Who can take each?

Roberto Diaz: I can own AMIs/OVAs and the partner images bucket. Will upload EdgeBox AMIs by Thu EOD and post checksums. Will also bundle marketplace package tarball.

Liam O'Connor: SI demo mostly wired but seeing intermittent 401s when demo broker exchanges service account tokens in staging. Repro steps below. Working with infra to trace.

Ava Singh: Marketing will produce blog draft, press kit zip, and 3 landing variants (self-serve, enterprise, partner co-sell). Localized copy for EN/JP/ES. Target drafts by Wed for review.

LegalBot: Heads-up: export/compliance checks required for EdgeBox images (contains encryption libs). Legal signoff ETA Thu 2025-07-31 12:00 PT.

Roberto Diaz: Upload command I'll run:
```bash
partner-cli package upload --src ./edgebox-ami --dest s3://partners-edgebox/releases/2025-07-30 --meta "partner=EdgeBox,ver=1.2.0"
```

Liam O'Connor: Repro snippet for 401:
```bash
# staging demo token exchange
curl -X POST https://staging.auth.redwood.internal/token \
  -d "client_id=demo-client&assertion=$JWT" | jq .
# sometimes returns 401 {"error":"invalid_grant"}
```

Maya Chen: Assigning owners: Roberto => EdgeBox images + package; Liam => SI demo + token triage; Ava => blog/press + landing + localization; LegalBot => compliance signoff. Everyone ack?

Roberto Diaz: ack. I'll post checksum and staging hero URL.

Liam O'Connor: ack. Infra found a clock skew on one staging node causing token validation failures; patching now. If unresolved by freeze, fallback = recorded demo + runbook note.

Ava Singh: ack — blog embargo draft ready Thu AM. Need hero image from Roberto's staging to finish. Will prepare localized CTA variants too.

release-bot: CI: marketplace-listing-build #451 succeeded ✅ artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood.internal/marketplace/451

Maya Chen: Proposed embargo lift: 2025-08-03T16:00Z. PR team to lift. Ava confirm with PR.

Ava Singh: Confirmed — PR team will lift at 2025-08-03T16:00Z pending legal. I'll send final checklist for the lift.

Maya Chen: Added runbook entry: if token exchange persists, demo fallback = static recorded demo + QA checklist. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-edgebox

Roberto Diaz: Staging preview: https://staging.marketplace.redwood.dev/edgebox — creds in 1Password. I'll snapshot hero at 1200x628 for blog and push to assets bucket.

Liam O'Connor: Patch CL posted for clock skew fix, CL: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/changes/876. Will monitor staging token logs and report by EOD.

Maya Chen: Dry-run scheduled Mon 2025-08-03 09:00 PT. Last signoff Tue EOD. Thanks all :rocket:
